verdict.heading: Your result
verdict.waiting: Running. Home shows progress if you leave.
verdict.analyzing: All runs are saved. Working out the result...
verdict.failed: The test stopped before a result. Open it to see which runs failed.

explain.improved: B solved clearly more tasks than A, beyond chance.
explain.regressed: Setup B solved clearly fewer tasks than setup A. Hold off on releasing it.
explain.inconclusive: Not enough evidence to tell the two apart. Run more tasks.
explain.invalid: The measurement broke. Fix it and run again.
explain.score: The share of tasks your setup solved, with a 95% range.

meaning.improved: Same tasks, setup A (baseline) and B (candidate). B solved more, by more than run-to-run noise.
meaning.regressed: Same tasks, setup A (baseline) and B (candidate). B solved fewer, by more than run-to-run noise. Releasing B would likely make things worse.
meaning.inconclusive: Same tasks, setups A and B. The gap could be luck. That does not make them equal. Run more tasks or tries.
meaning.invalid: Some runs broke for reasons outside the agent, such as a workspace failing to start. No result comes from broken runs.
meaning.score: Each run was graded. The score is the share solved. The range shows how much it could move. Nothing was compared.
